rule: Every character, prop, surface, creature, weather force, and environment element mentioned or required by a panel must define environment_interaction, motion_or_state_change, material_or_body_response, sound_or_silence, script_evidence, and visual_support_status. Any missing or unverified field fails the panel before Kling.
